correctness.rationale: For each total order of K_(2,n), a graph vertex produces a strong matching exactly when it has one earlier neighbor. Inspecting the positions of the two high-degree vertices exhausts all matching facets: two disjoint complexes D_a,D_b, each a central (n−1)-simplex with n attached ridge simplices, and 3n maximal cross-component edges. Every facet has an explicit realizing order. Each D_i admits an explicit S_n-equivariant deformation retract to its central simplex, so contracting both yields a two-node multigraph with 3n edges and integral wedge of 3n−1 circles. Relative H1 exact sequence is ker(sum:(Z^n)^3→Z) and rational trace 3 Fix(σ)−1. Face vector f_(r−1)=2[C(n,r)+nC(n−1,r−1)]+3n·1_(r=2). Independent enumeration of all (n+2)! orders for n=3,4,5 reconstructed all matching sets and exact facet/face model (face vectors (12,27,8),(16,48,32,10),(20,75,80,50,12)).
residual_risks: Contraction is of CW subcomplexes; integral module result follows relative exactness, not finite mod-two ranks.
